INSERT INTO device_otk_counts (user_id, device_id, algorithm, count)
        SELECT
            $1, $2,
            split_part(key_id, ':', 1),
            COUNT(*)::int
        FROM one_time_keys
        WHERE user_id   = $1
        AND   device_id = $2
        AND   claimed   = FALSE
        GROUP BY split_part(key_id, ':', 1)
        ON CONFLICT (user_id, device_id, algorithm)
        DO UPDATE SET count = EXCLUDED.count
